negative_findings.description: No Czech payment gateway (GoPay, Comgate, ThePay, PayU CZ, Shoptet Pay, Besteron) was found to publish a recurring, structured statistical report of transaction volumes or payment-method mix. Quantitative figures surface only sporadically inside blog posts, press clippings and journalist interviews.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched cs and en for gateway 'statistiky', 'tisková zpráva', 'objem transakcí'; found only narrative datapoints (e.g. Comgate: QR ~20% of gateway transactions, transfers ~20%; ThePay: ~CZK 7bn processed, ~4,000 merchants).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Acceptance-side method mix must be assembled from scattered vendor claims with differing definitions and no methodology, so any resulting series is low-comparability and needs heavy provenance tagging.

negative_findings.description: APEK's flagship E-commerce Study appears to be free for association members only, with non-members getting summaries or paid access; full methodology and payment-method tables may therefore be unavailable to open collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: APEK article headline explicitly states the 2025 E-commerce Study is free for association members.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single best structured survey of Czech online payment-method share may need a membership or purchase decision rather than crawling.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of a Czech merchant-side association or gateway consortium publishing aggregated interchange/MSC (merchant service charge) statistics; the only merchant-cost datapoint located was a one-off SOCR ČR internal survey covering seven large chains for 2022.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language searches on 'poplatky za karty obchodník', 'mezibankovní poplatek maloobchod' returned advocacy articles, not a statistical series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Acceptance economics (cost per accepted card transaction) is a core input for POS/terminal market sizing and has no recurring Czech public source.

negative_findings.description: POS/cash-register vendors (Dotykačka, Storyous) hold rich physical-acceptance card-vs-cash data but were not found to publish any aggregate statistics; their public sites are purely product marketing.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language search on 'data z pokladen tržby statistiky karty' returned only product pages, reviews and comparison articles.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Offline retail card-vs-cash mix at SME level remains invisible in this cell without a commercial data partnership.

negative_findings.description: ThePay (thepay.cz) and Besteron CZ (besteron.cz) were identified only through third-party coverage and comparison articles in this pass; their canonical domains and news pages were not directly fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: No fetch attempted; treated as hypothesis, not as dead or blocked.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two of the named cell actors still need first-party URL confirmation before being added to a collection schedule.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-owned and international acquirers serving Czech merchants (Global Payments CZ / KB SmartPay, Worldline, Nexi, ČSOB, Komerční banka, Air Bank's 'Cvak' A2A scheme, Adyen CZ) were not individually scouted in this pass, although Comgate's disclosures show Cvak is already material.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated acquirer/A2A sweep in cs: 'KB SmartPay statistiky', 'Global Payments Česko akceptace karet', 'Worldline Česko terminály', 'Cvak Air Bank platby e-shop objem'.

coverage_gaps.description: Large individual merchants that disclose payment-mix or basket statistics (Alza, Rohlik, Mall/Allegro CZ, Notino, Dr.Max) were not covered; their annual reports and PR can carry acceptance-side datapoints.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sweep top-20 Czech e-shops' press rooms and annual reports for payment-method and AOV disclosures.

coverage_gaps.description: Official statistical and regulatory anchors for the acceptance side (ČSÚ e-commerce/retail statistics, ČNB payment-system statistics, Eurostat ICT usage) were deliberately out of this cell but are needed to normalise the commercial claims collected here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure another cell covers ČSÚ/ČNB/Eurostat, and cross-link so gateway and association figures can be reconciled to official denominators.

coverage_gaps.description: Most acceptance-side quantitative claims found are point-in-time PR statements without back-series; only Heureka's quarterly Insider offers a genuinely repeating time series.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the Heureka Insider series first as the spine, then attach dated gateway/association datapoints to it with explicit provenance and definition notes.

coverage_gaps.description: Access and licensing terms were not verified for the two most valuable structured portals (data.apek.cz and ceska-ecommerce.cz), nor were their underlying data endpoints inspected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch both portals, inspect network calls for JSON endpoints, and read their ToS/robots.txt before scheduling automated collection.

brief: The Czech acceptance-side landscape has three usable layers: trade associations (APEK, with its E-commerce Study and the newer data.apek.cz portal, plus SOCR ČR for merchant card-cost advocacy), platform/marketplace operators (Shoptet's ceska-ecommerce.cz real-time portal and Heureka Group's quarterly eCommerce Insider, which is the only genuine recurring time series found), and payment service providers themselves (Comgate, GoPay, ThePay, PayU CZ, Shoptet Pay, Besteron, plus BNPL players Twisto and Skip Pay). Almost none of the PSPs publish structured statistics; their method-mix numbers — Comgate's ~20% QR and ~20% bank-transfer shares, ThePay's volume disclosures — appear only inside blog posts, press clippings and journalist interviews, so the series must be assembled datapoint-by-datapoint with heavy provenance tagging. Czech-language search was essential and materially outperformed English here: 'platební brána', 'platební metody', 'dobírka' and 'srovnání platebních bran' surfaced actors and figures that English queries returned only as vendor country-profile estimates (PPRO, NORBr). The main open risks are the membership gate on APEK's full study, unverified access terms on the two portals, and an unscouted acquirer/A2A tier (Global Payments/KB SmartPay, Worldline, Air Bank 'Cvak') that Comgate's own numbers suggest is already significant.
